observed_bug: Actual client/server both have Core0.3.16 and the registered Dodge backend, but client reads a server-side-only modList cache and refuses V.
actual_Forge_facts: Forge1.12.2 FMLClientHandler has no getServerModList method.
Client handshake validates server ModList without setting NetworkDispatcher.modList; that per-dispatcher client map is empty.
ChannelRegistrationHandler posts CustomPacketRegistrationEvent with packet origin NetworkManager and local target Side.CLIENT for server advertisements.
REGISTER can arrive before ClientConnectedToServerEvent and before play handler/world.
adaptation: Retain exact receiving manager proof for the server-advertised valeorders_dodge channel introduced with Core0.3.14. Do not use globally registered local channels.
A synchronized cache retains at most4weak manager identities and checks referential equality. Registration requires local targetCLIENT; UNREGISTER and matching disconnect revoke only that manager.

Current open NetHandlerPlayClient manager must match. No channel or unknown connection fails closed. When an explicit remote Core version exists, unsupported/old/malformed versions still refuse. Empty native client version map relies on the advertised protocol channel, not a local version guess.
Existing world/body/connection input and pose resets are preserved. Same-manager respawn keeps its network handshake capability.
One bounded NARUTO_DODGE_SERVER_READY log per current manager proves accepted native registration without IP,UUID or product UI implementation details.
